name: Horsemen - Live med Plateslipp (VINYL).
description:
Tor Dybdahl and his gang of four are eager to show off their new MPC sequencer slash sampler slash rhythm-machine, a true workhorse who's  perfect fit complementing the worn and scratchy old school synths.
Indeed the somewhat animated synthesizers, identifying as high-heeled prancers, who, more or less accidentally, slips and falls into juxtaposition with the poppies' drowsy relentless steady trot.
Much like their new double album "Make it RED" in its exclusive shiny transparent red vinyl.
A Must See - Must Hear - Must Have

Leona Sahara: Vocals
Niord Alexander: Guitar
Ignacio Garate: Guitar
Tor Dybdahl: Vocals, Synthesizers, Sequences & Samples
and Just Maybe a Special appearance by the General Horsemaster Himself, a Man Called Sannergata
